## Summary

Brief description of what this PR changes and why.

## Related issue

Closes #<issue-number>
Refs #<issue-number>

## Type of change

- [ ] bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] new feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] breaking change
- [ ] docs / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] I opened an issue / discussion first (for anything beyond a typo).
- [ ] My change fits the project mission: typed, testable, provider-agnostic.
- [ ] I added/updated tests in `tests/`.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint` pass locally.
- [ ] I updated `README.md` / `docs/` where relevant.
- [ ] I added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] I did not add a runtime dependency (or justified it in the PR description).

## Notes for reviewers

Anything reviewers should pay extra attention to, or context that won't be
obvious from the diff.
